title: Checkbox list
description: A list of options to tick, in three styles. The checkbox icon morphs into a tick when you select it.
pageTitle: Animated Checkbox List & Radio Group in 3 Styles | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it on settings and preference screens: notification channels, opt-ins or filters. Pick square or round checkboxes for multiple choices, or the radio style when only one option is allowed. Each option has room for a short hint that explains the choice.
whenToUse.alt: Animated checkbox list in three styles: checkbox icon morphs into a tick when selected

accessibility: Real checkbox and radio inputs wrapped in labels, grouped by fieldset and legend.
The hint text is part of the label, so it's read together with the option.
Native keyboard support: Space toggles a checkbox, arrow keys move through radios.
The focus ring is drawn on the visible tick, so keyboard users always see where they are.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: A checkbox with an icon for a tick
fragments.note: The input stays; the icon is what you see. It follows data-checked on the label.

fragments.title: Mirror checked into an attribute
fragments.note: A few lines let the icon follow a native checkbox.

fragments.title: Resting, hovered, chosen
fragments.note: Plain CSS rules; the icon inherits colour. No transition.
